title: Middlesex
author: Jeffrey Eugenides
summary: Cal Stephanides narrates three generations of a Greek family, from Smyrna to Detroit, and explains how a family secret led to his being born intersex. He also tells of growing up as a girl.
readIf: you like big, voice-driven family sagas with history and humour.
skipIf: you prefer short novels or are uneasy about a story centred on a gene and family incest.
